sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” It is through the scriptures that we have our patience and our comfort. The war between America, Israel and Iran, Israel killing people in Lebanon, the plan for a greater Israel that would take Jordan, Syria, part of Turkey, part of Kuwait and more, and kill millions to do it: none of that should shake the people of God. They shall fail, because the scriptures say so.

This is not our war; mind your business. But do not think for a second that these events will not touch us. It is good to be glad to see the prophecy fulfilled, because that is how deliverance comes, but you had better be right. Some of you are rejoicing at the prophecy and you yourselves are not right, brothers and sisters, husbands and wives.

If you are here and do not know what is about to happen, you should have prepared your mind already. The Bishop, the Deacons and the Captains have taught class after class on it, and for some it went in one ear and out the other. The scriptures were written aforetime for our learning, so that we would not be caught off guard.

America and Israel attacked Iran; Iran did not attack America. NATO was built so that an attack on one is an attack on all, yet now Spain, Italy and France have shut their bases and airspace to America's war, Poland refused its missiles, and thirty-five nations met to reopen the Strait of Hormuz without inviting America at all. The world is watching a divorce between America and NATO, and it has never happened before.

That is the prophecy. “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”, these nations, shall hate her, “and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” The woman here is America. They will turn against America, and this split is only the beginning.

You cannot tell me the Bible is a white man's book. The prophecy is coming to pass exactly as it is written. That is why we are living in the greatest time, and why Christ said to watch and pray: those who do not watch the news and pay attention are clueless to what is unfolding.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” God does nothing unless he reveals it to his prophets, and we are the prophets. Years ago, six years ago, the Bishop broke down the book of Revelation to the teeth and connected it with Daniel, and now we are seeing it come to pass in front of us.

That is the power you hold in your hand. Ask a megachurch pastor with thousands in his church what is about to happen with this war, and he has no idea. A fourteen-year-old son of Israel understands it. Why? Because the Most High reveals his secret, his prophecies, what they are about to do, to his servants the prophets.

This Bible has secrets that nobody knows except the prophets of Messiah. The brothers who say there is nothing else to learn in it are laughable.

precepts.why:
“He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” God found out all the ways of knowledge and gave it to the Israelites, to the prophets. That is the same thing Amos says: his secret is revealed to his servants.

So when events happen, you should not be shocked. If you study like you are supposed to and take notes in class like you are supposed to, nothing that happens in these last days should surprise you, here or online.

Stop listening to the Western news. When Donald Trump threatened to wipe out a whole population in forty-eight hours and send them back to the stone age, people panicked. He is running his big mouth; that is not what the prophecy says. The Western media want you to believe Iran has no power and no weapons, but the scripture says they are coming with great power. The prophets should know not to listen to that trash.

sense.text:
“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high”. This is Edom, Esau, and his pride.

This man went into Venezuela and kidnapped a president, and not one soldier was killed. So now, in the pride of his heart, he thought he could do it again: go into Iran, kill the top men, and watch the whole government fall. They thought Iran, Hezbollah, Hamas and the Houthis were weak and that this was the best time to strike. They found out the hard way. The pride of his heart deceived him, and he is in for the surprise of a lifetime.

“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” Those prophets have come back, and they are us. We have always prophesied against many countries and against great kingdoms, and America is a great kingdom. What you see now we have done before; this is not our first time. We prophesy against evil.

We might look small, and some say there are only a few of us. Do not let that fool you. The Most High is looking for 144,000 leaders, and you are looking at them. Some brothers have low self-esteem, and that is why they let their wives disrespect them.

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”. Evil is coming to America. They say Iran has no missiles that can reach here, and some of you believe it, and that is why you think you are safe. Stop being a damn fool. They want you to believe that.

The witchcraft of this place has our people thinking none of the evil going on abroad will ever come here, so they keep twerking, fighting in the airports, ransacking stores, even twerking on Elmina Castle in Ghana. Know for certainty that it is going to come here; the Lord has bombs with their names on them.

And there will be a lot of betrayal in these last days. Some of it will come from inside your own house. Prepare for that.
“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Do not let the media deceive you, and do not let these pastors deceive you.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” Some of you will be deceived. Some will walk out of this truth and go back to the Christian church when it gets hot, and some brothers will leave when their wives say let's go, and follow them right out the door because she says she did not sign up for this.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”. A rumour is "I'm going to send them back to the stone age, I'm going to wipe out a whole population." Christ says “see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass”. Not maybe; must. If you want deliverance, those things must come to pass. Millions of people are going to die, and when you see it, do not worry about it; it is through that that deliverance comes. We are not praying for it to stop, and we are not praying for peace in the Middle East.

If you think there is ever going to be peace on earth while the white man is ruling the earth, you are more stupid than anyone thought. If you want peace on earth, the Israelites have to take over and the white man has to go: all of them, not this one or that one, because all of them are the seed of evil doers, the seed of Satan. Christ, the black Messiah, said all these things must come to pass.

“But the end is not yet.” What we see in the Middle East is not even the beginning of World War III yet. It is the beginning of the gathering of the nations into the valley of Jehoshaphat that Joel spoke of.

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: America against Iran, Iran against Israel, Russia against Ukraine, people dying in Sudan and the DR Congo. “And there shall be famines”.

There are two kinds of famine. There is the famine where you cannot find the food, and the famine where the food is there and you cannot afford it. Either way you die hungry. The negro thinks he is smart and loves to play with words: there is food right there, so there is no famine. There is famine. Ten slices of cheese for seven dollars, three steaks for seventy-five, ground beef for thirty dollars, a case of soda that was three or four dollars now nine. A hundred dollars used to shop for the week and now cannot shop for two days, and they did not give you a raise; they cut your hours. That is famine. The Bishop told you six years ago to buy these things and put them in storage, and some of you laughed him to scorn, right in his face: this is America, it will never happen here. Something that was $2.99 six years ago is fifteen dollars now. The negro thinks he is smarter than everybody else and that nobody can teach him anything; then the teaching is for the humble one sitting next to him.

The connection is this: the war is affecting the whole world. In the wealthy nations working people are sleeping in cars, vans and tents because rent eats their paychecks; white people sleeping in their cars. That is a kingdom falling. After all these devils did to our people, it is payback time, and the payback has not even started yet. Then “pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.”
“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” Christ says all these things are only the beginning. The prices, the rent, the gas, the war: it is just the beginning of sorrows.

“And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.” Don't think there won't be betrayal; all these things must come to pass. Some of you will be offended, and the one who betrays you may be your wife, your husband or your children.

Offended at what? At the word of God. Offended that Christ is black, offended that Esau cannot get the kingdom, offended that the white man is Esau. Brothers will betray too, not only sisters, because of what is coming.

precepts.why: “All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.” That is the betrayal and the hatred of Matthew 24:10. Those who hate you whisper together against you and devise your hurt, and in these last days some of them will be in your own house.

sense.text:
Some brothers are married to broken women. A sister, after a class on marriage and how a wife is to submit to her husband, told her husband to find himself another wife, because she was not doing anything men told her to do. A broken woman is unlovable: no matter what you do, you cannot love her enough, and she will never be satisfied. Many of them have father issues.

The woman who has been traumatized wants love, but when she gets it she is suspicious of it, rejects it, tests it and punishes the one who loves her, because all her relationships have been chaos. A brother gets his life together in this truth, marries her and tries to bring peace, and she cannot accept it because she is used to chaos: why are you nice to me, why are you not abusing me? That has been seen in IUC too. That is psychological sickness and a dangerous spirit, and those are the ones who will betray you in these last days.

Black people are the only people on the planet who do not understand what honour is. A big-mouthed woman was angry that the congregation clapped when the Bishop came in. That same negro woman will clap for Donald Trump, clap for her boss, and clapped in the evil church, but in Israel she has a problem. Then go; you are taking up space and breathing air you are not supposed to be breathing. In these last days there is no time for a big black mouth woman.

War, famine, relationships and women all come together: it is one event unfolding in front of your eyes, like a chessboard. As a man of God, a prophet and a leader, do not overlook anything; the minute you miss something, you are done. Some of you brothers, your wife will betray you.

“Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.” Do not tell her everything. She will use what you say to destroy you. This is for the emotional brothers who think they have to tell their wives everything; that is not what the scripture says.

“For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.” That is betrayal.

You know who your enemy is when someone does not like you, and you keep your eyes on him. But the woman sleeping in your bed, you are not keeping your eyes on her. Whenever we speak of betrayal and of agents sent into our midst, we always think of the men, of Judas Iscariot. That same Judas spirit is in some of these sisters too.

Izola Ware Curry, a black woman, stabbed Martin Luther King with a letter opener at a book signing in Harlem a decade before his assassination and nearly killed him. He did not expect it from a black woman. Esau is the devil, we all know that, but Esau is not going to come into your house and stab you.

Your enemy, brothers, is in your own house: eating your food, wearing your clothes, in your bed. It is your blind spot, the subtle thing in the blind spot of your spirit, the one who has crept up closest to you while you were busy with other things.

precepts.why:
Christ says the same thing Micah said: “For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law. And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.”

This is not a man's word; it is Christ's. A man's foes are they of his own household, the blind spot, the one you will not see coming. And it is not only sisters who will betray; brothers will betray too.

sense.text:
“These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.” These men are not defiled by women.

The Bishop has always said that if you really want to know a brother, wait until after he gets married. Everything changes about him; the minute he smells something, his mind is gone. These are the men who were not defiled by women and who follow the Lamb wherever he goes.

“And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips”: this is about the prayers of the sisters, and the power God gives to men you think are nothing.

We might look like a bunch of nothing right now, but we are the sons of the living God, the gods of this earth, and there are no greater men on the planet. A time is coming when every mouth will shut when you see the men of God. Sister, look at the man you are married to. If you leave him, you will never find another man of that caliber again; you will die before you do. That man is the prophets of the Bible. So be very mindful what you think and say about him, even to your wicked family members in the world. There is a God.

“And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand”. If you pray and your husband hears it and says nothing, your prayer stands, and the Most High will honour it.

“But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect”. If your husband hears the foolishness coming out of your mouth, he can disallow it and tell Messiah not to listen to it. Some of you will go to Messiah and pray, kill him; your husband can say, Lord, do not listen to that trash.

That is the power God gives the husband over the wife. This is for the big-mouthed woman telling her husband to find himself another wife because she will not do what he says. Don't get mad at us; we are reading the Bible and showing you the power the Most High gives.

“If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth”, and her father hears it and holds his peace, “then all her vows shall stand”. “But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.”

This is for those who have no husband: God also gives the father power over the daughter.

“Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.” After war, betrayal and family, now the unity of the brotherhood, which is very important now: many gifts and administrations and operations, but the same Spirit, the same Lord, the same God.

“For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ. For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free”. “For the body is not one member, but many.” All of us play a part in the body of Christ, and in the end we are all one under Christ. We all unify in the spirit of Christ, the northern kingdom and the southern kingdom alike.

“Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary”. We do not all play the same part; some play a bigger part than others. That does not mean you are not important. Cut off one finger from the hand and you can see the effect it makes.

“That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.” The members are us. “And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.” We all wear purple; we are on the same team. You should not come against me, and I should not come against you; that is what the world does. One of us wins, it is a win for us all; one of us is honoured, it is an honour for us all. The black woman should let that sink in.

For the first time in life we are in something bigger than ourselves; we were nobodies, and here we are treated with respect. In the world we did not see black men honour other black men, sit and listen to other black men, open the Bible and show each other how to live and how to keep a marriage. It was always "this is not working, I'm out." It takes a man to fix it and a little boy to walk away. A man can grow up in a house with a father and learn nothing from him, and not become a man until he comes into IUC. In this truth there are men like Bishop Nathanyel and the other Bishops who are fathers, who do not only teach it but live it, and those are the men to honour.

Even a man in the world understands that a people who play as individuals cannot get ahead: you play along with the team even when you do not like what the group is doing, because wealth and power follow the numbers. Some in the truth do not understand it. They come in and challenge men who were in the truth thirty years before them. At camp they are too prideful to ask the brother next to them where a scripture is, because they do not see themselves as a team, and so evil sits right in front of them unaddressed. Unity brings strength.

There are laws in the Bible for how we govern ourselves toward our leaders, our elders, our bishops and deacons. “Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head”: the gray-headed, the elders. You stand on your feet in their presence. When you hear Bishop on deck, Deacon on deck, it should not grieve your spirit if you are keeping the laws of God. God commands us to show respect and honour to our leaders.

“And honour the face of the old man”. That word honour is a hard thing for a negro; ask him to spell it in a spelling bee and he will spell c-a-t. We have fallen far from the glory the Lord created us in. Honour, like unity and preferring one another, is a quality we lack as a people, and the Lord has to tell us to work at what should come naturally. The younger men have risen up proudly against the ancients, against the men in the seat of leadership.

“And fear thy God: I am the Lord.” If you have an issue with rising before the elders, the bishops and the deacons, there is a lack of the fear of God in you, because this is his commandment. We did not make it up; we are following the commandments of God.

precepts.why:
“When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!” The gate is where the leaders sat to judge the matters of the city, and Job prepared his seat there. “The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.”

As Job made his entrance, as leaders make their entrance, the people rise before them. It is a law to rise up before them. Some think we made it up when we call Bishop on deck, that IUC is doing its own thing. No, it is the commandment of God.

Unity is not just agreement. Unity is oneness in purpose, in spirit and in truth. There is protection in unity, there is strength in unity, and there is power in unity.

Peter repeats the same thing that was read in Leviticus: “Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.”

This is the brotherhood right here. If you love the brotherhood, you will not be shaming the brotherhood.

sense.text:
“Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another”. Why would the Most High put it in there if we were already doing it? Exhorting means honouring one another. If a brother does something good, there is nothing wrong with honouring him and letting him know.

If you have two children, one with a bad grade and one with a good grade, you do not honour both; the one with the bad grade should be ashamed so that next time he works harder for the same sneakers his brother got. That is what a negro cannot do. In the world we are crabs in a barrel; when one of us does good, we curse him out. The black community does not honour the young man who works hard and is the first in his family to go to college; it throws a party for the negro coming out of jail who was destroying the community with drugs. Now that you are in the truth you should have a different mind. Every chance we get, we should honour each other.

“And so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.” It is going to get harder and harder, so as the day approaches we should exhort and honour one another more and more. A win for you is a win for us all.

“Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.” To rule well is to be an example to the men, to the women, and especially to the young men. The Bishop has been in this for over twenty years, putting his bricks in, longer than some of you have been alive.

Those who labour, who put works into the word and doctrine, are counted worthy of double honour. We come from a society where it is fine to disrespect the black man, and that cannot be allowed here. Whoever comes in to disrespect our brothers, especially our elders, will get a warning, maybe two, and then has to go. You might as well go back to that Christian church.

“Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.” The key word is agree. We have to agree in doctrine, in spirit, in the teaching and in judgment. Whatever we ask, the Most High will do it, but we must agree.

That is why IUC does not join with the other camps. We do not agree with their doctrine: not the doctrine of two-thirds, not the doctrine that a man can sleep with a thirteen-year-old. There is a lot we do not agree with. And they do not honour our elders, and the order and structure of a congregation is one of the main parts of the growth of a nation. If they will not honour our elders, there is nothing to discuss.

“For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.” Verse 20 speaks of verse 19. Why would we gather in Christ's name with those we do not agree with? Christ's name is found in the scriptures, so every time we come together our focus should be the scriptures. We are gathered here in Christ's name because we agree. Where men gather and do not agree, Christ is not in the midst of them; they are just running their mouths.

“For honourable age is not that which standeth in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years.” Honourable age is not about how old you are. Some say they are too old for these young men to tell them what to do. God does not care how old you are; you can be old and an old dummy that nobody wants to listen to.

An older woman with gray hair, married three times, who you would think should have wisdom to guide the young sisters, tells her daughter to have sex before marriage and to live with a man before marriage. That is an evil woman, and why the black community is the way it is.

“But wisdom is the gray hair unto men, and an unspotted life is old age.” There is a reason the Most High has called some of you in your old age so the younger men can teach you: some of you are no good in your old age. The Most High sends the young men to help you, and instead of embracing it you say no one can teach you anything. Then you will die in your sin.

precepts.why:
“He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.” Look how the Lord deals: just because you think you are wise in your old age, he will take away your understanding, so that no one should trust what an old fool says.

We are to learn from the aged, but it is not in the number of years. Daniel's wisdom was called upon while he was a young man, and Paul told Timothy to let no one despise his youth; he was a younger man made an elder over the church. Our people think that because you are up in age you automatically get the respect, but it is about the wisdom the Lord placed in you, and the Lord can remove it.

Many of the prophets were called young and set over congregations because the aged, who were supposed to have the wisdom, did not. They judged wrongly, took bribes and were engulfed in lust, like the elders in the History of Susanna. Our leaders in Israel United in Christ have proven themselves over time through the scriptures and applied them, and that is why they are given the honour they deserve.

sense.text: “Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble”. Everything taught today, the war, the famine, the betrayal, has been about Jacob's trouble. Some think Jacob's trouble is just going through some hard times. No. Jacob's trouble comes with everything, and we are all going to go through it.

precepts.why:
“Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.” Because you keep God's word, he will keep you from the hour of temptation, the hour of trouble.

Jacob's trouble is going to be our trial. God is going to try you to see if you are worthy of the kingdom. It is not going to get easy; the famine, the rising food costs and the rising gas are only the beginning. In the midst of all of it, make sure your spirit is right with Messiah.

sense.text:
“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.” To examine yourself does not mean you are in sin; it means stop and look at yourself. Brothers want to examine everybody except themselves. Are you watching porn? Things keep happening to you, a car accident, a lost job, a lost car, your wife about to leave, and you say you did nothing. You are doing something you have no business doing, and lying to yourself and to us.

Whether you be in the faith: the faith is about Christ. Nobody here knows you better than you know yourself. Do not call and ask what you should change about yourself; you know exactly what you should change. Maybe stop watching porn.

“Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you”. You know your own self. Stop it.

“The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble”. We all know trouble is coming and our trial is coming. God is good in the day of trouble, if you keep the law. “And he knoweth them that trust in him.”

We are moving into a place where you will have no choice but to depend on the brother and the sister sitting next to you. One thing about black people is that we do not work well together. God is going to change that whether you like it or not, because a point is coming where if we do not work together, none of us will make it.

“I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.” That verse will not work if we do not work together. IUC helps many brothers and sisters outside of America; at Passover every school abroad has to get lambs and garments and rent a hall, and it costs money. The righteous are not forsaken nor their seed begging bread because we work together to make sure brothers and sisters have what they need. For that verse to come to pass we have to trust and depend on each other.

That is not talking about the one who was told to save food six or seven years ago and said to hell with the Bishop. Had you bought a hundred dollars of groceries every year since the Bishop taught it, you would have rice and beans now. America has spoiled some of you, who have never seen famine and cry about no hot water. In the islands many houses have no water heaters, and a brother in Sierra Leone last year went two weeks without hot water and still took a shower every day. Some will not make it because they have been spoiled.

“For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth”. What you see now is the beginning, and there is nothing you can do about it; the prophecy is coming to pass. “And ye shall remain in them”: many of us will be alive to see it.

“For God shall not deliver you, because ye have sinned against him.” Imagine all these things happen, the war, the famine, the disease, the chaos, and this verse is talking about you. You did not get delivered because you were not right. You never took the time to repent and keep God's laws, and some cannot wait for the Sabbath to be over to break them. Your children, your wife or your husband who are not right will die right here.

After all Esau put you through in this captivity, to end up not making the kingdom is a terrible card to be dealt, all because you refused to change.
